race.description: Community Bank Fleurieu - Bendigo Bank Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: FRONTPOINT (6) put a clear marker on this race when winning at this track by five and a half lengths last start, beating Enciphering after being well-found in betting. That was his best recent figure and he keeps the successful rider combination, so he sets the standard if he holds that level. THEBIGSOSSO (1) is the strongest danger after resuming with a sound third at Gawler, beaten two and a half lengths, and his record around 1350m is clearly superior to most of these. ATOMIC TIME (2) has the quick turnaround, a 2kg claim and a recent maiden win over Pretty Morsel in his favour, with his Class 1 sixth last week good enough to keep him in the winning mix if he settles better. FOREVER WAITING (3) knuckled down strongly when finished 1.5 lengths from the winner at Penola. Worth including again. REFRESHING (10) comes through a BM64 at Halidon where she was only beaten just under two lengths at big odds, and the quick back-up gives her a genuine each-way chance.
